# Pipeline & Agent Architecture Checklist: Agentic UC Pipeline

**Purpose**: Validate completeness, clarity, and consistency of pipeline orchestration, agent architecture, retry logic, and HIL requirements
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Pipeline Step Definition Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are all 9 pipeline steps defined with explicit input, output, and success criteria? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the boundary between LLM-powered steps (1-6) and deterministic steps (7-9) clearly documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the intermediate data contracts between sequential steps specified (what step N outputs and step N+1 consumes)? [Gap, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is step 6's dual responsibility (Python script generation + simulator config generation) clearly scoped with separate success criteria for each? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are steps 7-9 (schema validation, test execution, report generation) specified as non-LLM deterministic processes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-039]

## Agent Architecture Requirements

- [ ] CHK006 - Is the parent orchestrator/pipeline controller's responsibility clearly defined — sequencing, state passing, error routing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the requirement that agents MUST NOT share conversational state testable — are the allowed inter-step communication channels exhaustively listed? [Measurability, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are per-agent prompt externalization requirements specified with a concrete format (e.g., YAML template files in `prompts/`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-037, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are structured output enforcement requirements specified for each generation agent (steps 3-6) — which Pydantic models or ADK output schemas? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the integration pattern between Google ADK agents and liteLLM/OpenRouter model backend documented? [Gap, Spec §FR-038]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are agent tool definitions (ADK `@tool` functions) specified for each agent step, or is the tool set left undefined? [Gap, Spec §FR-037]

## Pipeline State Management

- [ ] CHK012 - Are all pipeline run states (pending, running, paused_hil, completed, failed, cancelled) and their valid transitions defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the requirement to preserve pipeline state during HIL pauses specified with enough detail to determine what "exact point of interruption" means? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are the conditions under which a pipeline transitions to each failure state (failed vs. cancelled) unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is the server-side pipeline continuation behavior (when browser closes) specified with recovery semantics — how does the user reconnect to a running pipeline? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are concurrent pipeline run restrictions clearly stated as a constraint (single-user, no concurrent runs for v1)? [Completeness, Assumptions]

## Retry Logic Requirements

- [ ] CHK017 - Are the two retry mechanisms (test-failure vs. infrastructure) clearly distinguished with separate configuration, counters, and behaviors? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is "test-failure retry" scoped — does it retry only the failing step, or all steps from the failing step onward? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is the retry error context specification complete — exactly which fields (error message, failing test case, expected vs. actual, CIQ record) are fed back to the agent? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are infrastructure retry parameters (exponential backoff multiplier, initial delay, max delay cap) fully specified or left as implementation choice? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is the behavior defined for when a retry produces a config that passes old tests but fails a new test — does this consume a retry attempt? [Clarity, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are retry attempt audit requirements (logging prompts, responses, outcomes per attempt) specified with enough detail for FR-015 compliance? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]

## Human-in-the-Loop (HIL) Requirements

- [ ] CHK023 - Is the HIL trigger condition precisely defined — what constitutes "cannot derive required information" for each document type (CIQ, MOP, constraints, command outputs)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are HIL requests limited to steps 1-2 (document analysis phase) per FR-028, or can later generation steps also trigger HIL? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is the HIL request payload structure specified (field, document section, agent inference, question, options)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are requirements defined for batching multiple HIL requests (all ambiguities presented together vs. one at a time)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the HIL timeout/expiration behavior specified — what happens if the user never responds to a HIL request? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are requirements defined for HIL response validation — can the user provide an invalid response, and how is that handled? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Few-Shot Knowledge Base Requirements

- [ ] CHK029 - Is the trigger for adding a new entry to the knowledge base specified (only on successful pipeline completion, or on partial success)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-036]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is the similarity matching approach specified with enough detail to evaluate feasibility (embedding model, distance metric, threshold)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-036]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are requirements defined for knowledge base growth management — what happens with contradictory examples (same UC type, different configs)? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the few-shot context formatting requirement specified — how are past examples inserted into agent prompts? [Gap]

## Document Processing Pipeline

- [ ] CHK033 - Are chunking trigger conditions specified — at what document size/row count does chunking activate? [Clarity, Spec §FR-035]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is the chunk aggregation strategy specified — how are partial intermediate representations merged without data loss? [Completeness, Spec §FR-035]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are requirements defined for handling CIQ Excel files with multiple sheets — which sheets are processed and how conflicts are resolved? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK036 - Is the intermediate representation schema specified with enough detail for all 9 downstream consumers to use it unambiguously? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026]

## Cross-Cutting Concerns

- [ ] CHK037 - Are pipeline execution logging requirements (FR-015) specified with granularity — which events, at what verbosity, in what format? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK038 - Is the pipeline event stream contract (for real-time UI updates) specified with all event types and payloads? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK039 - Are requirements consistent between the pipeline cancellation behavior (FR-019) and the run history persistence (FR-018) — is a cancelled run with partial artifacts browsable? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK040 - Is the regression diff requirement (FR-040) specified with matching criteria — how does the system identify "same UC" across different pipeline runs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-040]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items tagged `[Gap]` indicate missing requirements that should be added to the spec
- Items tagged `[Ambiguity]` indicate requirements that need clarification before implementation
- Focus areas: pipeline steps, agent architecture, retry logic, HIL, few-shot, document processing
